subject.title: RFC: Period-based popularity for publishers, skills, and plugins

question: Should ClawHub standardize trailing 7-day and 30-day popularity across creators, skills, and plugins, and what activity score and creator ownership-attribution rule should define V1?
rationale: Current main only provides separate seven-day skill and plugin foundations; monthly ranking, creator aggregation, score alignment, ownership transfers, and rollout semantics cannot be safely selected by automation.

options.title: Standardize shared periods
options.body: Use trailing completed-day windows, preserve all-time ranking, and define one explainable activity score with event-time creator attribution.

options.title: Keep current trending
options.body: Retain independent skill and plugin Trending views and defer Monthly and creator period ranking.

options.title: Stage explicit semantics
options.body: Allow surface-specific period features only when each UI clearly labels its available metric and window until a shared contract exists.

recommendation.title: Standardize shared periods
recommendation.body: Use trailing completed-day windows, preserve all-time ranking, and define one explainable activity score with event-time creator attribution.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and repeatedly maintained the publisher and creator discovery surface and authored this RFC.
